subject.title: tools.exec.approvalRunningNoticeMs is documented but rejected by the 2026.3.24 config schema

question: Should maintainers adopt, replace, or close https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/1652 before starting another repair path for this issue?
rationale: The issue remains valid, but an open non-mergeable fork PR already claims the exact fix and the prior same-repo PR was closed as superseded by stale/conflicting branch state.

options.title: Replace With Narrow Repair
options.body: Close or supersede the fork candidate and open a clean schema-only repair against current main, preserving source credit where appropriate.

options.title: Adopt The Fork Candidate
options.body: Ask the fork author or a maintainer to rebase and remove unrelated stale systemd changes before reviewing it as the fix path.

options.title: Close The Candidate Only
options.body: Close the conflicting fork PR without starting a replacement, leaving this issue open until a later maintainer-sponsored fix is ready.

recommendation.title: Replace With Narrow Repair
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the fork candidate and open a clean schema-only repair against current main, preserving source credit where appropriate.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the exact same-repo repair commit that matches the remaining schema mismatch.
